[[Abyss]] |download=https://blaps.se/qw/loc/QHLAN2024_Map_Pack.zip |loc= }} Designed for the QHLAN2024 Prewar Tournament, '''QHLAN2024 Map Pack''' features three new 1on1/2on2 maps along with a map-hub for level selection. They were created by {{player|infiniti|flag=ca}}, {{player|alice|flag=se}} and {{player|bps|flag=se}} during September/October [[:Category:2023|2023]]. Drawing inspiration from the [https://youtu.be/0VROwdt-kWI?si=FnEwLB9_vih8gwk- QHLAN trailer] 'Ridge of Reigning Champions' by {{player|bps|flag=se}}, the maps are set amongst the slopes and caverns of a dark stone mountain - dotted with lava flows, imposing black cliffs, and shimmering magical crystals, watched over by monuments to Champions of the past.
